candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear wahala. E no get fever. Dem no see convulsion now and e never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic or unconscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Dem count pikin breath for one minute. Pikin chest dey go inside when e dey breathe. Pikin dey calm when dem observe am. Cough don last for 3 days. Pikin na HIV exposed or infected. Pulse oximeter no dey. E no get recurrent wheeze. E respiratory rate na 35. E no get stridor when e dey calm. E no dey wheeze.
